name: Cairo and Nile Cruise Honeymoon Tours by Sleeper Train
description: Spend your Honeymoon Packages in Egypt and explore Cairo Tours with amazing Nile Cruise Tour between Aswan and Luxor by visiting the incredible sightseeing from Aswan to Luxor such as Philae temple, Aswan High dam, Kom Ombo and Edfu temples with full day tour in Luxor visiting Karnak temple and Luxor temple and explore the west bank in Luxor, visit the valley of the kings, Hatshepsut temple and colossi of Memnon
overview: Spend your Honeymoon Packages in Egypt and explore Cairo Tours with amazing Nile Cruise Tour between Aswan and Luxor by visiting the incredible sightseeing from Aswan to Luxor such as Philae temple, Aswan High dam, Kom Ombo and Edfu temples with full day tour in Luxor visiting Karnak temple and Luxor temple and explore the west bank in Luxor, visit the valley of the kings, Hatshepsut temple and colossi of Memnon
highlights: Visit Edfu Temple & East Bank of Luxor

itinerary.title: Arrive Cairo
itinerary.description: Once your flight landing at Cairo Airport, Ibis Egypt Tours representative will be waiting for you, holding a sign with your name, then he will transfer you to your hotel in Cairo, check into you hotel, at 6 Pm our Ibis Egypt tours representative will pick you up for Giza Pyramids Sound and light show in Pyramids area, after you finish transfer back to your hotel. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Cairo Day Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy tasty breakfast at your hotel, then Ibis Egypt tours tour guide will escort you to Pyramids of Giza and the Egyptian Museum, start your tour by visiting the three Pyramids of Cheops, Chephren and Mykerinus, then move to Panorama area, enjoy fabulous photos for the three Pyramids, next move to the Sphinx, visit the Valley Temple, Enjoy Lunch at local restaurant in Cairo, continue your tour by visiting the Egyptian Museum, it is one of the most famous museums in the world, at the end of your day tour transfer to Giza train station, check into sleeper train, and have dinner. Overnight on the sleeper train

itinerary.title: Nile Cruise / Aswan Day Tour
itinerary.description: Wake up to the beauty of Aswan as your Ibis Egypt tours representative greets you at the train station. Prepare to explore the wonders that await you. Begin with a visit to the majestic High Dam, a marvel of modern engineering. Next, marvel at the Unfinished Obelisk and delve into the history of the mighty Philae Temple, dedicated to the goddesses Isis and Hathor. As the day ends, you'll be escorted to your Nile Cruise, ready to embark on an unforgettable journey from Aswan to Luxor enjoy a delectable dinner onboard your Nile Cruise and spend a restful night as you sail along the Nile's tranquil waters. Overnight onboard your Nile Cruise

itinerary.title: Kom Ombo Temples Tour
itinerary.description: Breakfast on board, enjoy the scenic sailing to Kom Ombo, and explore the Temple dedicated to the two gods Sobek and Horus. Afterward, continue sailing towards Edfu, where you will have lunch on board. Overnight on board your Nile Cruise.

itinerary.title: Visit Edfu Temple & East Bank of Luxor
itinerary.description: Enjoy your breakfast on-board. Try a new adventure by a horse-drawn carriage to visit the Edfu Temple of God Horus. Then return to the Nile Cruise, and continue sailing to Luxor via Esna lock. Once the cruise arrives in Luxor, visit Luxor Temple and Karnak complex on the east bank of Luxor. After that, you will go back to your cruise. Enjoy your dinner on-board. In the evening, enjoy the Galabia Party on the cruise. Overnight on board your Nile Cruise

itinerary.title: West Bank of Luxor Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy your tasty breakfast on board, sail towards Luxor, Start to embrace the culture, walkthrough Valley of the Kings, head out towards the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, visit the magnificent Colossi of Memnon, check into sleeper train, and have dinner. Overnight on the sleeper train

itinerary.title: Final Departure
itinerary.description: Today we will say goodbye to Egypt, once you enjoy your tasty breakfast in train, Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Cairo International airport for final departure.

inclusions: Meet at Cairo International Airport plus transfer to hotel by air-conditioned vehicle.
One night accommodation in Cairo including breakfast and all taxes
Three Night’s accommodation at 05 stars Nile Cruise including breakfast, Lunch, Dinner.
Two night’s accommodation in Sleeper train with Breakfast and dinner
Sleeper train ticket Cairo / Aswan - Luxor / Cairo
One day excursion in Cairo as mentioned at the above itinerary
Excursions on board your Nile Cruise including visits to:
The High Dam, Unfinished Obelisk, and Philae Temple
Valley of the Kings, Hatshepsut temple, and Colossi of Memnon, Karnak and Luxor Temples
One Lunch at local restaurant in Cairo
A Bottle of Mineral Water to each person
English speaking guide at the sightseeing in Cairo
English speaking guide at the Nile Cruise
Entrance fees to the sites as mentioned at the above itinerary
Transfers in Cairo / Aswan / Luxor by air-conditioned vehicle
Transfer to Cairo International airport for final departure.
